[1] Kayn's E, Shadow Step, grants you move speed and the ability to go over walls. You also get healed upon entering terrain for the first time. Important thing to note is that this ability will only last for a short amount of time if you are not inside the terrain or you are in combat.

[1] In the majority of your games, you will get your passive around minute 10. So you can safely farm your jungle and not worry about it too much. At around minute 10, you should be able to get your form with your first item.
[1] When it comes to ganking, you want to use your E through a wall to get behind the enemy in order to cut off their escape path.
[1] As we've established already, your ult can only be used on targets that you have damaged.
[1] Your ult is also the only defensive tool that you have in your kit. So make sure to play around its cool down.
[1] Rhaast's passive makes you heal for a percentage of damage dealt to enemy champions with your abilities.
